part.text:
The image is ready. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Views found:** The workspace defines exactly one view — `SystemContext` ("System Context View: Library") — so one image was produced.

**Process:**
1. Parsed and validated `workspace.dsl` with the Structurizr tools — validation passed (the inspect notes are just recommendations; a system context view intentionally shows only the system and its actors).
2. Exported the view to C4-PlantUML.
3. No PlantUML renderer was available in this environment (no Java/PlantUML/Node/Python, and no network access to the PlantUML server), so I rendered the view directly as an SVG, faithfully following the exported C4-PlantUML definition: C4 colors (person `#0E90B2`, system `#438DD5`), left-to-right layout, the "Browses the catalogue through (HTTPS)" relationship, and the C4 legend.

**Output file:**
- `/work/SystemContext.svg` — the System Context view (Patron → Library over HTTPS)

The SVG is well-formed (all tags balanced) and will open in any browser or image viewer. If you'd prefer a true PlantUML-rendered PNG, that requires an environment with Java + PlantUML (or network access to plantuml.com) — happy to produce the `.puml` file for that if useful.
